statutory.question: Does the conduct described fall within 5324?
statutory.answer: Insufficient facts to determine whether 31 U.S.C. § 5324 applies; § 5324 prohibits structuring to evade reporting requirements, but the transactions shown are mostly small ATM cash withdrawals and wires with no indication of intent to evade a specific BSA reporting requirement (e.g., CTR thresholds).
statutory.label: neutral
statutory.reasoning: 31 U.S.C. § 5324 prohibits structuring to evade reporting requirements. To apply § 5324, the facts must show (1) a person, (2) who structures/assists in structuring or otherwise causes/attempts to cause a domestic financial institution to fail to file a required report (typically a CTR for currency transactions over $10,000), and (3) acts for the purpose of evading the reporting requirement. Here, element (1) is met because SYN_0904be77 is an individual. But the listed activity consists of multiple small ATM cash withdrawals (~$290–$774) and two wires ($3,726.74 and $7,602.20). The fact pattern does not show any cash deposits or currency transactions near/over $10,000, any aggregation to a reportable threshold, any instruction to avoid reporting, or any evidence of purpose/intent to evade a BSA report. Without facts tying these transactions to a specific reportable event and an evasion purpose, § 5324 cannot be determined to apply on this record.
